export { anatomy, parts, type SelectPart } from "./select.anatomy";
export { connect } from "./select.connect";
export {
  getBackdropEl,
  getBackdropId,
  getCancelTriggerEl,
  getCancelTriggerId,
  getContentEl,
  getContentId,
  getEnvironmentEl,
  getHiddenSelectEl,
  getHiddenSelectId,
  getIndicatorId,
  getItemEl,
  getItemEls,
  getItemGroupId,
  getItemGroupLabelId,
  getItemId,
  getItemLabel,
  getItemValue,
  getPositionerEl,
  getPositionerId,
  getTriggerEl,
  getTriggerId,
  getValueTextId,
  hasSymbolGutter,
  ITEM_SELECTOR,
  isItemDisabled,
  ownsFocus,
} from "./select.dom";
export { machine } from "./select.machine";
export type {
  ResolvedSelectMachineProps,
  SelectApi,
  SelectDismissDetails,
  SelectHighlightChangeDetails,
  SelectItemGroupLabelProps,
  SelectItemGroupProps,
  SelectItemIndicatorProps,
  SelectItemProps,
  SelectMachineProps,
  SelectOpenChangeDetails,
  SelectPresentation,
  SelectPresentationProp,
  SelectSchema,
  SelectValueChangeDetails,
} from "./select.types";

import { type Anatomy, type AnatomyPart, createAnatomy } from "../../machine/anatomy";

/**
 * No `root`, the same divergence as `dialog`, `popover` and `menu`: the trigger
 * stays where the author wrote it and the surface is portalled, so the two are
 * siblings with nothing above them. No `arrow` either — no tang is drawn
 * on a pop-up, exactly as with the menu.
 *
 * What the menu has and this one deliberately does not: `itemDescription`,
 * `itemShortcut`, `triggerItem` and `contextTrigger` are menu furniture. What
 * this one has and the menu does not: `valueText` (the trigger reflects the
 * selection) and `hiddenSelect` (the native form mirror, CDC §4.5).
 */
export type SelectPart =
  | "trigger"
  | "valueText"
  | "indicator"
  | "hiddenSelect"
  | "backdrop"
  | "positioner"
  | "content"
  | "itemGroup"
  | "itemGroupLabel"
  | "item"
  | "itemSymbol"
  | "itemText"
  | "itemIndicator"
  | "separator"
  | "cancelTrigger";

export const anatomy: Anatomy<SelectPart> = createAnatomy("select").parts(
  "trigger",
  "valueText",
  "indicator",
  "hiddenSelect",
  "backdrop",
  "positioner",
  "content",
  "itemGroup",
  "itemGroupLabel",
  "item",
  "itemSymbol",
  "itemText",
  "itemIndicator",
  "separator",
  "cancelTrigger",
);

export const parts: Record<SelectPart, AnatomyPart> = anatomy.build();

export {
  Select,
  type SelectComposedProps,
  type SelectEntry,
  type SelectOption,
  type SelectParts,
} from "./composed";
export {
  type SelectApi,
  SelectBackdrop,
  SelectCancelTrigger,
  SelectContent,
  SelectHiddenSelect,
  SelectIndicator,
  SelectItem,
  SelectItemGroup,
  SelectItemGroupLabel,
  type SelectItemGroupProps,
  SelectItemIndicator,
  type SelectItemProps,
  SelectItemSymbol,
  SelectItemText,
  SelectPortal,
  type SelectPortalProps,
  SelectPositioner,
  SelectRoot,
  type SelectRootProps,
  SelectSeparator,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValueText,
  type SelectValueTextProps,
  type UseSelectProps,
  useSelect,
  useSelectContext,
} from "./select";
